description: This Java class, SubscriptionsReader, manages local subscription data, providing methods to create instances, query subscribers for given topics, and check topic subscriptions. It is a utility component within a pub/sub system.

classes.name: SubscriptionsReader
classes.description: A utility class for reading subscription data, mapping topics to subscribers and subscribers to their filters.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates an empty SubscriptionsReader instance with no subscriptions or filters.

methods.name: fromImmutableMaps
methods.description: Constructs a SubscriptionsReader from provided immutable maps of topic-to-subscriber and subscriber-to-filter relations.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves subscribers for the provided collection of topics, applying subscriber filters.

methods.name: containsTopic
methods.description: Checks whether the specified topic has any subscribers.
